# SEQ Campers

Premium off-road caravan dealer on the Sunshine Coast, Queensland, Australia.
Three decades selling hand-picked Kimberley Kampers and Stockman Caravans.

- Showroom: Mon-Wed 7:30am-3pm, Thu-Fri 8:30am-3pm, Sat 8:30am-12:30pm, Sun closed

## What we sell
- Kimberley Kampers - premium off-road caravans, made in Australia
- Stockman Caravans - off-road caravans, made in Australia
- All stock is hand-picked, inspected, and prepared by Shane personally before listing
- 30+ years industry experience, 2,000+ subscribers on YouTube

## Key pages
- /                - Home with featured caravans and 5 FAQs about the business
- /stock           - Current caravan inventory with brand/status/price filters
- /stock/[slug]    - Per-caravan listing pages with full specs, photos, configurator, and 5+ FAQs
- /sold            - Archive of recently sold caravans
- /about           - Company background and team
- /contact         - Phone, email, enquiry form, and map

## How buyers work with us
Every buyer can use the on-page configurator to tick upgrade options
and receive an indicative price. We follow up with a written quote
within one business day. Inspections welcome on the Sunshine Coast
by appointment only - call (07) 5370 7933 to book.

## Schema markup available
- Product (per caravan, with Offer, AutoDealer seller, additionalProperty specs)
- AutoDealer / LocalBusiness (homepage)
- FAQPage (homepage + every caravan detail page)
- BreadcrumbList (caravan detail pages)
- Open Graph + Twitter Card on every page

## Service area
Queensland (primary), all Australian states (delivery available).
